de: Songthaews (Sammeltaxis) sind die günstigste Möglichkeit, zwischen Krabi-Stadt und Ao Nang zu pendeln.
Meiden Sie die Monsunzeit (September-Oktober) für Inselhopping, da viele Bootstouren storniert werden.
Besuchen Sie den Tigerhöhlen-Tempel (Wat Tham Suea) am frühen Morgen, um der Hitze beim Aufstieg von über 1200 Stufen zu entgehen.
Die Flusspromenade von Krabi-Stadt bietet in der Abenddämmerung den besten Blick auf die Khao Khanab Nam-Felsen.
hu: A legolcsóbban a songthaew nevű iránytaxikkal tudsz utazni Krabi város és Ao Nang között.
A monszun idején (szeptember-október) a szigettúrák és hajóutak gyakran elmaradnak, ezt vedd figyelembe a tervezésnél.
A Tigrisbarlang-templomot (Wat Tham Suea) kora reggel látogasd meg, hogy elkerüld a hőséget az 1200 lépcsőfok megmászása közben.
Sétálj a folyóparti sétányon naplemente környékén, innen a legszebb a kilátás a Khao Khanab Nam sziklákra.
ro: Songthaew-urile (taxiuri comune) sunt cel mai ieftin mod de a călători între orașul Krabi și Ao Nang.
Evitați sezonul musonic (septembrie-octombrie) dacă plănuiți tururi pe insule, deoarece bărcile sunt adesea anulate.
Vizitați Templul Peșterii Tigrului (Wat Tham Suea) dimineața devreme pentru a evita căldura în timpul celor peste 1200 de trepte.
Promenada de pe malul râului este perfectă la asfințit pentru a admira stâncile Khao Khanab Nam.
en: Songthaews (shared pick-up trucks) are the cheapest way to travel between Krabi Town and Ao Nang.
Avoid the monsoon season (September-October) for island hopping, as boat trips are often cancelled.
Visit the Tiger Cave Temple (Wat Tham Suea) early morning to escape the heat during the 1,200+ step climb.
The riverfront promenade is best experienced at dusk for views of the Khao Khanab Nam limestone karsts.

en.tip: Best enjoyed at the riverside restaurants in Krabi Town during the evening.

de.name: Maharaj Market

hu.name: Krabi Town Walking Street

hu.name: Maharaj Market
hu.tip: Kora reggeli piac, ahol rengeteg egzotikus gyümölcsöt és fűszert fedezhetsz fel.

ro.name: Maharaj Market
ro.tip: Piața de dimineață este locul perfect pentru a cumpăra fructe exotice și condimente thailandeze.

en.tip: The weekend night market is the best spot for street food and handmade souvenirs.

en.name: Maharaj Market
en.tip: The bustling morning market is perfect for picking up exotic fruits and local spices.

de.name: Thara Park
de.tip: Ein friedlicher Park am Krabi-Fluss, ideal für einen abendlichen Spaziergang.

de.name: Khao Khanab Nam Höhlen

hu.name: Thara Park
hu.tip: Csendes folyóparti park, tökéletes egy esti sétához vagy kocogáshoz.
